tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "tax_mismatch", "line": null, "cause": "wrong_tax_rate", "evidence": [{"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-035#3.1", "detail": "Contract states every invoice is subject to PPN of 11% of the subtotal as the tax base."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "MCB26100389", "detail": "Invoice charges tax of 73980 on a subtotal of 616500, i.e. a 12% rate, above the 11% the contract allows (11% would be 67815.00)."}, {"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0075", "detail": "PO prices are exclusive of PPN (contract clause KTR-V-035#2.3), so the 11% rate applies to the 616500 subtotal."}], "explanation": "The tax amount of 73980 equals 12% of the 616500 subtotal, whereas contract clause KTR-V-035#3.1 fixes PPN at 11% of the subtotal (67815.00), so the invoice applies the wrong tax rate."}]}
